gate_d_note: Nothing here has been executed against the scheduler. Creating the automation is an outward action: it installs a recurring job on this machine. It is created only after Mike types APPROVE f2031-scout-weekly-1 and ~/.rig/proof/gate-d-f2031-scout-weekly-1.json exists with status APPROVED. The create command carries --disabled so even creation leaves the job off; enabling it is a second, separate approval.
cadence_note: Mondays 17:00 America/Denver. Weekly satisfies 'at least once a week'; the scrape window is 9 days, so a missed run cannot leave a gap.

mechanism.stage_1_deterministic: python3 scripts/weekly_capability_scout.py stage --since-days 9   # scrape + citation verification; writes only .context/capability-scout/<week>/
mechanism.stage_2_agent: An Orca automation/terminal session reads that week's brief.md + queue.json and emits DRAFTS only, per data/capability-scout-prompt.txt.
mechanism.stage_3_human: Mike reviews the drafts; rig-capabilities test must pass on each; installing and committing are separate actions.

orca_command: orca automations create --name "Capability scout (weekly)" --trigger "0 17 * * 1" --timezone America/Denver --disabled --repo path:/Users/rig128gb/Developer/rig-capabilities --precheck "test -f data/capability-scout-sources.json" --provider claude --prompt "$(cat data/capability-scout-prompt.txt)"
orca_command_note: Staged, never executed. The precheck fails the run if the channel registry is missing or has no enabled source, so a broken registry cannot silently produce an empty week. --prompt takes the text of data/capability-scout-prompt.txt; there is no --prompt-file flag.
never: install a skill, agent, hook, harness, loop or command into any harness root
publish, post, send, email, or DM anything
git push, deploy, merge, or tag
attempt to access channel-membership-only videos by any means
cite a paper or repository that is not in week.json's verified sets
enable an automation without a separate approval
termination: A run ends when stage has written week.json + queue.json + brief.md and the agent pass has written drafts plus a REPORT naming every rejected citation. There is no autonomous promotion path: the loop closes on a human reviewing drafts.
